description: This file implements the hardware layer logic for ion sense detection, including handling signal state transitions, callbacks, and initialization routines related to engine revolutions and external digital input handling in a firmware project.

classes.name: CdmState
classes.description: Represents the state of the ion sense detection, tracking current revolution and signal accumulator.

methods.name: CdmState::CdmState
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CdmState object.

methods.name: CdmState::getValue
methods.description: Returns the current signal value accumulated.

methods.name: CdmState::onNewSignal
methods.description: Updates the state based on a new signal received for a given revolution.

methods.name: ionPostState
methods.description: Placeholder function for post-processing ion sense state, only included when EFI_TUNER_STUDIO is enabled.

methods.name: extIonCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on external interrupt, updates signal state based on current engine revolution.

methods.name: cdmIonInit
methods.description: Initializes the ion sense input, sets up external interrupt if configured properly.
